IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUSTICE
KING'S BENCH DIVISION
Claim No. KB-2026-000418

BETWEEN:

PERPETUA ASHGROVE                                        Claimant

and

BRIARWOOD FREIGHT SERVICES LIMITED                       Defendant

WITNESS STATEMENT OF CORNELIUS FAIRBROTHER

I, Cornelius Fairbrother, of Flat 4, 18 Larkspur Road, Bristol BS6 5QT, say as follows.

1. I am the Claimant's neighbour. I make this statement from my own knowledge.

2. On 14 March 2026 I drove Mrs Ashgrove to the depot at Unit 7, Harbourside Trading Estate, Avonmouth BS11 9YT. The yard manager, Mr Tregarthen, told her that the pallet had been released to another carrier.

3. Mrs Ashgrove telephoned the Defendant's office on 020 7946 0583 the same afternoon. She later gave me her mobile number, 07700 900241, so that I could confirm the times.

4. She has told me that the goods were insured for £48,750.00 and that the Defendant offered £6,000 in settlement on 2nd April 2026.

5. The claim was issued in the County Court at Bristol before it was transferred to the High Court.

6. The Defendant's solicitors have since written that the claim will be heard in the High Court of Justice, Business and Property Courts in Bristol, Circuit Commercial Court (KBD). They wrote again about claim KB-2026-000418 on 18 April 2026.

Statement of truth
I believe that the facts stated in this witness statement are true.

Signed
Cornelius Fairbrother
Dated: 21 April 2026
